units.source_text: 积起来的沙子上滴入了汗水，其上，又落下了沙子……

en.t: Sweat dripped onto the piled-up sand, and over it, more sand fell again...

units.source_text: 女人的肩膀颤抖着，男人也热极了，仿佛马上就要涨开来了……

en.t: The woman's shoulders were trembling, and the man too was so hot he felt as if he would swell and burst at any moment...

units.source_text: 尽管如此，女人的大腿还具有如此强烈的诱惑力，真搞不清是怎么回事……

en.t: Even so, the woman's thighs still held such a powerful allure that he could not understand what was happening...

units.source_text: 简直像抽掉了体内的中枢神经，一根一根地缠绕上女人的大腿……

en.t: It was as if the central nerves had been drawn out of his body and were twining one by one around the woman's thighs...

units.source_text: 食肉动物的食欲，就是这样的吧……

en.t: This must be what the appetite of a carnivore is like...

units.source_text: 鄙俗地、贪婪地、像装进了弹簧似的憋足了劲……

en.t: Vulgar, greedy, braced with tension as though a spring had been wound inside...

units.source_text: 同那个人一起的时候，从来没有经历过如此的专心。

en.t: When he had been with that other person, he had never experienced such total concentration.

units.source_text: 在那床上，他们感觉到了男人和女人……

en.t: On that bed, they sensed man and woman...

units.source_text: 一旁瞧着的男人和女人……

en.t: The man and woman watching from the side...

units.source_text: 一旁瞧着感觉到男人的男人，一旁瞧着感觉到女人的女人……

en.t: The man watching from the side and sensing the man, the woman watching from the side and sensing the woman...

units.source_text: 瞧着男人的男人被女人瞧着，瞧着女人的女人被男人瞧着……

en.t: The man watching the man was watched by the woman, and the woman watching the woman was watched by the man...

units.source_text: 对照的两面镜里映出的，性交无限的意识化……

en.t: Reflected in two opposing mirrors, sex became an infinite act of consciousness...

units.source_text: 幸好由阿米巴虫连续而来，将近十亿年历史的性欲，很少有这样的磨损吧……

en.t: Fortunately, sexual desire, continuous since the amoeba and with nearly a billion years of history, is probably seldom worn down in this way...

units.source_text: 但现在我所需要的，就是这种贪婪的性欲……

en.t: But what I need now is precisely this greedy sexual desire...

units.source_text: 迎着女人的大腿，神经兴奋得络绎不绝地爬出来。

en.t: Toward the woman's thighs, his excited nerves came crawling out without end.
